<!-- pr-reviewer: 5bd7ff4ddc8ebc472abbafa76d7afb3f5a023025 -->
Reviewer: PR-reviewer agent (Claude Opus 5.5), dispatched by session m5bob via /review-prs on 2026-11-26T06:27Z; this agent did not write the change. Independent re-review from the diff; the earlier marker on this head (posted from the author's account) was not relied on.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

**What looks good**
- `sodick-ln2w.cps` is a separate script and `sodick-wire.cps` is untouched, so Mark 21 output is unchanged. The Mark 21 goldens and `wire_post` / `sodick_wire_post` suites stay green.
- The start order matches the owner's round-2 correction: `G00 X Y U0. V0.`, `Z0.`, `T91`, `T84`, `T94`, `C` word, then `G01`. The square golden shows this order. No G20/G21 is written, and `programUnits = "mm"` makes the engine refuse an inch document by name.
- Refusals are by name and write no cut: any taper (WireTaper, angle word, U/V lean, `dialect` without a taper), 4-axis, COMP/control offset, non-finite wire numbers, bad condition ids, a work offset outside G54-G59, rotary, tool change, canned cycle, rapid with the wire threaded, a first-cut arc, a Z change within a cut, and a skim with no `skim_flushing`. The taper is deferred to #4075 and the header says NOT VERIFIED ON A CONTROL.
- The skim pass takes its own flushing word and `C` word before its first move. No `unwrap`/`panic` in app code: `posting.rs` and `posting_files.rs` only register the post and the machine.
- Machine file: U/V +-40 mm, no `edm.taper_angle`, example conditions marked EXAMPLE and flagged in the program. The 100 mm guide span keeps a 20 degree lean (36.4 mm) inside the 40 mm half travel.
- Placement is correct: new `script_sodick_ln2w` binary has its reason in the body (per-script `post_suite!`, #926); no new `camcraft-*` dependency; no process files touched (`assets/posts/AGENTS.md` is not on the process list); no snapshot PNGs, CHANGELOG or `.claude/` edits; no build.rs/.github/scripts/Cargo.toml changes. The decision record is present. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #4045`.
- Test inputs under `testdata/models/edm/` come from the author's own fixtures repo, and the `step_agreement` file-set test now requires each STEP subdirectory to be pinned.

**Results merged with main** (main `a1c57b475`; run on the m3 review farm, not the self-hosted runner: the runner list returned 403, so none was counted online)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` | 871 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 68.0 min. It includes `kernel step_agreement`, `post script_sodick_ln2w`, `script_sodick_wire`, `sodick_*`, `comment_escape`, `app conformance`, `machine`, `wire_post`, `example_catalog`, `_adaptive`, `_edge_work`, and `ui lib` |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-kernel -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_sodick_ln2w` | 16 passed, 0 failed |

Windows-only readings: the diff adds no `cfg(windows)` or `target_os` lines.

**Targeted tests (step 5):** no existing toolpath or post changes. The Mark 21 post and goldens are unchanged and the catalog suites above are green. This is a P6 PR, so there is no targeted heavy step. The new post's goldens and refusal streams were read, and they pass.

| Step | Result | Head | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`) | Not run | `5bd7ff4ddc8ebc472abbafa76d7afb3f5a023025` | The m3 review-build script runs only the quick gate and clippy; the light lane was not run separately. It is a note, not a blocker. |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- Nothing has run on a control. The AQ600L U/V travel and 20 degree figures come from a brochure that neither the author nor this review could open. The header and machine description say to check them.
- `crates/kernel/tests/step_agreement/rows.rs` is 402 lines, at the soft ~400-line limit.
- The wire post writes `Z0.` on every start: the header tells the operator to set Z0 at the upper head height, which matches the owner's statement.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
